overview_description.description: One Degree provides a technology platform and service suite that helps individuals connect with nonprofit, government, and community resources. The company operates a web and mobile resource directory that enables users to search, review, and manage social services such as housing, food support, healthcare, job training, and benefits. It offers infrastructure solutions (e.g. closed-loop referral systems, data tracking, screening tools) to organizations like social service agencies, healthcare providers, and government bodies to coordinate care across systems. One Degree maintains a community access layer so users can freely explore resources, while offering enterprise modules that integrate workflows, reporting, and referrals for partner institutions.
